Name: Night Market - Run a Stall in Town Every Saturday
Author: XI221
Description:
[size=5][b]Night Market[/b][/size]
Every Saturday night (the 6th, 13th, 20th and 27th), strings of lights go up between the lamps in the town square and three stalls open: yours, Marnie's and Willy's. This is not the vanilla winter Night Market on the beach - it's a small weekly market in town, all year round.

[size=4][b]How a night goes[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]7:00 PM[/b] - the stalls go up. [b]7:30[/b] - Marnie and Willy arrive. [b]8:00 PM[/b] - the market opens, once it's fully dark in every season.[/*]
[*]Click your counter to rent the stall for the night (100g by default), put out up to 6 items (anything you could ship), and pick a price: cheap (x1.2), fair (x1.5) or high (x2) of the shipping price.[/*]
[*]Villagers drop by on their own until 11:20 PM. They look at Marnie's and Willy's stalls, then come to yours. If the price is right they just buy. If it's a bit high they haggle - accept, counter-offer, or refuse. If it's way too high they walk off.[/*]
[*]Everyone haggles differently: Pierre is shrewd, Penny is polite, Alex is generous, Pam is stingy. They'll pay more for things they love, and less for things the other stalls already sell.[/*]
[*]Step away from your stall and people who like the price leave the money on the table. People who want to haggle leave when they can't find you.[/*]
[*]Press [b]G[/b] near your stall to shout and call people over (once an hour).[/*]
[*]Click Marnie's or Willy's counter to shop at their stalls.[/*]
[*]At [b]midnight[/b] everyone heads home; at [b]12:30 AM[/b] you pack up and get a summary: what sold, for how much, who bought, and your best seller. Leftovers go back to your inventory; if it's full, they go to the lost and found at Lewis's house.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Growing your stall[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Upgrade your stall: level 2 for 2,000g (more visitors, 9 slots), level 3 for 5,000g (even more, 12 slots).[/*]
[*]The more you sell, the better your reputation, and the more people come.[/*]
[*]A villager who buys from you for the first time gains friendship (+15, +5 more if you accept their haggle).[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Which Saturdays[/b][/size]
Marked on the calendar. No market on festival days (Egg Festival, Spirit's Eve) or when it rains, storms or has green rain. Snow is fine. Small events elsewhere on the same day (Trout Derby, SquidFest) don't stop it.

[size=4][b]Good to know[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Single player only for now (in multiplayer the stalls would only show on the host's screen).[/*]
[*]Nothing is added to your save: the stalls are put up for the night and taken down after. You can remove the mod any time.[/*]
[*]If something blocks the square (a mod that changes the town, or something you placed there), the market waits and tells you which tile is blocked. Move it and the stalls go up within 10 minutes.[/*]
[*]Settings (with Generic Mod Config Menu): shout key, stall fee, how many visitors come.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Feedback wanted[/b][/size]
Did villagers come often enough? Were prices and haggling fair? Did anyone get stuck or walk somewhere strange? Which other mods are you using? The English text is new - if a line reads wrong, please tell me.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
SMAPI 4.0+. Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu. Languages: English, Chinese.

Fan-made mod; Stardew Valley characters and art belong to ConcernedApe.

[size=4][b]中文[/b][/size]
夜市：每周六晚上（6、13、20、27 号）镇广场的路灯之间拉起灯串，摆出三个摊——你的、玛妮的、威利的。19:00 摆摊，20:00 天黑透开张。点柜台租摊（默认 100 金），摆上能出货的东西、定个价，村民会来逛：价钱合适直接买，略贵就跟你砍价，太贵扭头就走，每个人脾气不同。站在摊边按 G 吆喝招人。24:00 散场、0:30 收摊出小结，剩货回背包或送失物招领。节日、雨天不开，下雪照开。只在单人游戏开，不往存档里加东西，随时可以删。
